profile.headline: Software Engineer at Verkada
profile.summary:
Programming Skills
- Fluent in Swift, C, and SQL
- Good understanding in C++, Java, Python, C#, and Objective C
- More than 10 years of C/C++ working experience
- 10 years of iOS / OS X programming experience
- 4 years of Android programming experience
- Specialized in network programming, security, cryptographic communication protocol design
- Experienced in iOS, Android (include JNI), RESTFul, PHP, C#, TCP/IP Socket, Shell Script, MS SQL, MySQL, Postgres SQL, Assembly, Linux Kernel Programming, XML, JSon, UML

Qualification Highlights
- A generalist with a wide range of programming language and project experience
- 20+ years experience in the IT industry

----------

Come work with me at Verkada! Email recruiting@verkada.com or learn about our culture on our careers page (linked below).

At Verkada, we're rethinking what it means to be physically safe. Today we build security cameras that detect action, identify danger, and help keep people and places safe and secure. Using a combination of software and hardware, we’re transforming an industry that has seen little innovation for decades. But this is only the beginning. Behind the scenes we’re a team of computer scientists, hardware engineers, and experienced founders united by the challenge of building beautiful products for real people—and by our commitment to using technology responsibly. We're backed by top investors, including Sequoia Capital, FirstRound, Meritech, and Siemens (Next47).

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
iOS
- interfacing between iOS and C++ SDK
- implement new features including stored speaker-play queue preset
- closely involving porting Play-Fi speaker daemon and implement an iOS application which is working as a wireless speaker

Windows
- migrate MFC based code to .Net based application
- integrate C++ SDK with C# Application
- implement a built-in web server of Speaker firmware update server
- closely involving UI implementation
- ported Play-Fi speaker daemon to allow connection from another Windows Play-Fi connection

SDK Development
- re-design Speaker firmware update server; implement cross-platform server between iOS and Windows
- optimizing and stabilizing protocol parser
- maintaining and optimizing SDK
